question: After the capability and TTL defects are corrected, must this PR show a live LiteLLM-to-Anthropic cache write/read before merge, or may maintainers explicitly override that external-provider proof gate?
rationale: Unit tests cannot establish LiteLLM forwarding, dynamic backend routing, Anthropic cache counters, or the resulting prompt-retention boundary; accepting less proof requires an intentional maintainer decision.

options.title: Require corrected live proof
options.body: Require redacted outbound payload evidence plus subsequent Anthropic cache-write and cache-read counters after the alias and one-hour TTL defects are fixed.

options.title: Override external proof
options.body: After the code defects are fixed, a maintainer may explicitly accept deterministic payload tests while owning the unresolved proxy compatibility and retention risk.

options.title: Pause behind the issue
options.body: Keep the linked canonical issue active and pause or close this PR if neither live proof nor an explicit proof override is available.

recommendation.title: Require corrected live proof
recommendation.body: Require redacted outbound payload evidence plus subsequent Anthropic cache-write and cache-read counters after the alias and one-hour TTL defects are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a provider-boundary proof-sufficiency choice, and the reviewed history connects this person to adjacent Anthropic live validation.
